annotation.title_clean: National Institute for Artificial Intelligence and Robotic Studies (Establishment) Bill, 2023
annotation.title_en: National Institute for Artificial Intelligence and Robotic Studies (Establishment) Bill, 2023
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Assembly of Nigeria (sponsored by Hon. Ademorin A. Kuye)
annotation.summary_en: Nigerian House bill (HB 143) establishing the National Institute for Artificial Intelligence and Robotic Studies in Somolu, Lagos. It sets up a corporate body with a governing board, academic board and officers to offer AI and robotics education and research. It contains no regulation of AI or robot systems.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes the Institute as a body corporate offering AI and robotics diplomas and certificates
Creates a Governing Board appointed by the Minister of Communications and Digital Economy
Aligns Institute teaching and research with the National Digital Economy Policy and Strategy
Sets out the powers of the Board, the Academic Board, the Director-General and the principal officers
The Minister is Visitor and may give policy directions to the Board
